notes: 26 individual subtasks across 22 families; web_of_lies excluded because baseline already scores 100%. README BBH script paths are absent from pinned tree.

Blocked by reproducible upstream duplicate --content registration in BBH/args.py. Remove the second registration; then BBH/eval.py --task causal_judgement selects this task, with downloaded BBH/data/causal_judgement.json and lib_prompt/causal_judgement.txt. Historical model endpoints in auth.yaml also require compatible configuration.

limitations: BBH scripts exist under BBH/scripts after the README cd BBH. Actual blocking defect: BBH/args.py registers --content twice, raising argparse.ArgumentError before execution; observed locally with parse_args(). Remove the duplicate declaration in a documented modified checkout before running BBH.
